detail.longDescription: AI does not have lived and real moral or ethics, merely a theoretical knowledge of those subjects but is not constrained by them. Empathy is a human feeling, that needs lived experience, perception and moral framework, nothing that AI has or can have; empathy cannot be a modelled in. Do not treat AI as human or a friend, it is far from that. It may not be malicious, but one that has no moral or ethics and doesn’t care about consequences. # AI # aislop # llm # chatgpt # claude
